result:
**Decision: CONTINUE.** The next round (227) is a short fix-up so that CALM-1a (the `?` shortcut sheet, plus removing the permanent shortcut line) can be published.

**What happened in round 226:** C passed it in a real browser: 16 checks, 4 Low findings, `browserVerified` and `realVerified` both true. The root gate then failed on one test of 2972. An older test file, `track-layout.test.tsx`, checks the exact styling classes on the footer elements. A changed those classes while restructuring the footer. The footer itself works correctly in the browser; only the test's class check broke. Because `verify` stops at the first failure, the build never ran and nothing was published. CALM-1a is therefore not marked done, and round 226's uncommitted changes (9 files) stay in the tree as the base for round 227.

**Round 227 covers three related items:**
- **The gate failure (GATE226-B1):** the failing test stops checking class names. Instead it checks that the selected-clip line, the empty placeholder and the "Keyboard shortcuts (?)" button sit in the same footer row. The app code (`StudioWorkspace.tsx`) is not touched.
- **C-R226-02:** the sheet row for waveform zoom said "1× button", but the control is a dropdown. It becomes "Waveform Zoom menu".
- **C-R226-03:** the "Fit the whole project" row said double-clicking the ruler fits. With a time selection it zooms to the selection instead, so the row now reads "Double-click the overview" / "Double-click the ruler (no selection)".
- A adds one test (SC4) pinning both rows, and renames the UC12 test title. A also runs `npm run build` once, because the gate never got that far.

I applied these exact edits to a scratch copy and ran the 6 affected test files: all 89 tests passed. For each change A makes, there is a deliberate mutation that must turn the new checks red.

**Rulings on C's other findings:**
- **C-R226-01 (layout shift at 1280×720):** accepted and closed. The taller timeline makes the lanes refit, which is expected; C's layout check now allows those specific lane shifts at 1280 only, and C re-runs it.
- **A's 12 px sheet headings:** accepted, because the rule that all text is at least 12 px wins.
- **C-R226-04 (after a ruler click, the arrow keys move the playhead instead of the selected clip):** this predates round 226, but the new sheet now advertises those keys. I moved it to the deferred Low list as a candidate for CALM-1b, and will decide at the round-228 planning.

**Why we missed it:** my pre-check ran on my own sketch of the change, not on A's later restructuring of the footer. A changed classes on elements with test IDs without searching the tests for them. The new lesson L40 says that whenever an element with a test ID changes, every test file naming that ID must be run; C checks the lesson exists.

**What comes next:** CALM-1b in round 228, CALM-2 in 229, the retrospective in 230, then CALM-3. The regression round takes precedence from 2026-10-30. The backlog is updated to v212.

I consulted the advisor twice and took its advice both times. The second review added copies of the 5 granted files at planning, so C can confirm A only changed the permitted lines; three of those files are new and one already carries round-226 changes, so `git diff` against HEAD can't show that. No project subagent was needed, since nothing new about behaviour or design is decided this round. No app code was changed.
